title.zh: SmartLingo V2 第三轮：显式 Max 试用与证据驱动定级
title.en: SmartLingo V2 round three: explicit Max trial and evidence-based placement

purpose.zh: 免费学习规划不再暗中消耗一次性 Max 试用；定级改用更广的真实场景，并显示证据与置信度。
purpose.en: Free learning planning no longer silently consumes the one-time Max trial; placement uses broader real-life scenes with visible evidence and confidence.

zh: 保存非初级课程偏好不再启动 Max；只有明确标注 7 天且不会自动收费的课程详情按钮才可申请试用。
十二种学习语言的五技能定级各有 15 题，跨 12 个场景；跳题不计错，低证据降低置信度，结果可改选。
旧版未完成测评与新版题目隔离，推荐等级指向实际课程。
新增受控的 Max 场景文字导师基础设施，但入口和接口默认关闭，尚未作为付费权益上线。
登录与 AI 兜底文案修正为真实 Free/Max 模式。
en: Saving a higher-level course preference no longer starts Max; only the clearly labeled seven-day course-detail action can request the trial.
Five-skill placement across twelve target languages now uses fifteen tasks spanning twelve places; skips are not errors, low evidence lowers confidence, and learners can override the result.
Separate unfinished legacy assessments from the new bank and route recommendations to actual courses.
Add gated Max scene-based text-tutor infrastructure, with entry and API off by default; this is not a launched paid benefit.
Correct login and AI-fallback copy to the real Free/Max model.

zh: 学习规划、官方课程报名、五技能定级、登录文案，以及关闭状态的导师表和接口；价格与支付不变。
en: Learning-plan save, official-course enrollment, placement, login copy, and dormant tutor table and API; prices and checkout are unchanged.

zh: 快速课程 POST 只读取 Max 权益；报名仅在同源请求显式携带 startMaxTrial=true 时才可启动一次性试用。
规划页先保存选择；非初级转到只读详情，由用户自愿开始试用；初级仍免费。
定级题版本升级，扩充场景来源，纠正跳题和低样本评分，显示作答数、跳题数与置信度。
文字导师限固定场景和角色，校验 Max、同源、轮数、时间、并发与每日配额；最近四组问答只供短期上下文，到期后由站点定时任务清理，功能开关未启用。
en: Quick-course POST only reads Max entitlement; enrollment starts the one-time trial solely when a same-origin explicit action sends startMaxTrial=true.
The planner saves first, then sends higher levels to read-only course detail for voluntary trial activation; Beginner remains free.
Version the assessment bank, broaden scene sources, correct skip and low-sample scoring, and display counts and confidence.

Constrain the text tutor to fixed scenes and roles with Max, origin, turn, time, concurrency, and daily-quota checks; purge four-exchange short-term context after expiry via site cron. The switch remains off.

zh: TypeScript、零警告 ESLint、459 项完整测试、生产构建、敏感扫描和 WebKit 240 项版式检查通过；精确提交部署门禁仍需执行。
第二轮匿名生产浏览器测试：英语咖啡店入口及慢速状态可用；日语内容安全暂停，公开 AI 助手进入离线兜底。第三轮发布后须复测。
en: TypeScript, zero-warning ESLint, all 459 tests, production build, sensitive scan, and the 240-case WebKit layout matrix pass; exact-commit deployment gates remain required.

Round-two anonymous production browser testing found the English café entry and slow-mode state working; Japanese content safely paused, and the public AI tutor returned its offline fallback. Recheck after release.

zh: 生产 AI 提供商目前走兜底，日语等十种目标语缺少可用的预审场景对话；需诊断凭证或上游并离线预构建 360 套目标语对话。
Max 文字导师默认关闭；实时语音、母语审校、普通付费账号端到端验收及教育效果校准未完成，不可宣传为已上线。
en: The production AI provider currently falls back, and ten target languages lack available pre-reviewed scene dialogue; diagnose provider configuration or upstream and prebuild 360 target-language sets.
The Max text tutor remains off; live voice, native-language review, ordinary paid-member end-to-end acceptance, and learning-outcome calibration are unfinished and must not be advertised as live.

zh: 沿用 SmartLingo 现有 Free 初级、Max 权益、十二语言、生活场景、AI 网关及五分钟站点定时任务；支付方式不变。
en: Reuse SmartLingo Free Beginner and Max entitlements, twelve languages, real-life scenes, existing AI gateway, and five-minute site cron; payment methods are unchanged.

rollback.zh: 导师默认关闭；如需回退可恢复上一成功 Worker，保留独立新表供安全清理，不删除学习记录或订阅。
rollback.en: The tutor is off by default; roll back to the prior successful Worker if needed and retain the isolated new table for safe cleanup without deleting learner records or subscriptions.
